required: exact current linked Encounter Document and revision
one declaration for every objective, clock, phase, and present public or GM stake
exact GM authorization bound to the Encounter Document revision
forbidden: mechanical writes encoded in narrative summaries

closedOutcomes.lifecycle: A complete allowed plan changes the Encounter Document lifecycle to completed and clears an active phase only through the closed phase conclusion.
closedOutcomes.preservation: Labels, visibility, maxima, stakes source text, notes, recipes, presentation, reserves, waves, and unrelated Encounter Document fields are never re-authored by settlement.

campaignConsequences.rule: GM-authored bounded consequence summaries are accepted narrative facts only. Any mechanical mutation requires a separately owned closed objective, clock, phase, reward, cleanup, or future authoritative provider.

fields: closed fact kind and source subject
facts.privacy: GM objective, stake, and campaign-consequence facts remain GM-only; their existence and summaries are not projected publicly.
facts.consequences: Objective, clock, and phase writes merge with matching current consequence authority; accepted narrative events use preserve snapshots and never delete unrelated consequence rows.

writePlan.aggregateRevision: All closed changes produce one Encounter Document revision.
writePlan.beforeAfterEvidence: The private plan retains stable-JSON SHA-256 before and after evidence plus the exact next Encounter Document.
writePlan.staleRule: Application rechecks the complete authority hash, current document revision and hash, next hash, and monotonic next revision.
writePlan.atomicRule: Missing decisions, denied GM authority, stale state, malformed narrative mechanics, or applied-evidence drift exposes no applicable write. P8-080 persists the write with the settlement batch.

completion.pending: Every omitted objective, clock, phase, or present stake remains a visible audience-scoped decision.
completion.denied: Denied GM authorization retains its private reason and blocks application.
completion.terminal: Committing, completed, cancelled, or already terminal settlement cannot be replanned.

privacy.safeProjection: Later UI may expose only audience-authorized labels, closed result status, bounded summary, progress, and pending state.
